The name Bavyesh carries the meaning “Lord of Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bavyesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Baveesh (Bhavya) was a renowned poet and philosopher during the Gupta Empire period (circa 4th-6th centuries CE). He is known for his work 'Kumarasambhava', which is a part of the epic Mahabharata.

Another reference to Baveesh (Bhavya) can be found in the 13th-century Indian literary work 'Alamkara-Sindhu' by Nandi Bhatta. He is described as an expert in poetics and a teacher of the court of King Bhoja of Dhar.
